CustomField.description:
ECMv2.1 field set by Placement workflow field update to capture the Placement sequence for retention placements (linked Placements within an agency contract).
How it works: - ECM_Sequence_Name__c is the field used to name each placement - ECM_Previous_Retention_Placement_Types is the field that stores the sequence up to the previous placement - ECM_Retention_Placement_Sequence__c (this field) is updated by workflow using the two fields above to set the sequence up to and including this placement
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The sequence of linked placements within an agency contract.
CustomField.label: ECM Retention Placement Sequence
